user.title: SPO Pool Heat Pump
user.description:
This integration speaks Modbus RTU on RS-485. Wire and join the USR-DR164 first. Full checklist: [/spo_pool_heat_pump/setup.html](/spo_pool_heat_pump/setup.html) (available after a restart; it links out to the wiring diagram).

1. Parallel tap +, A, B, and G on the heat-pump bus (same four pins as the factory WiFi). If the DR164 has a separate DC− screw, join it to G. Swap A/B if CRC fails.
2. Phone joins `USR-DR164-xxxx` → `http://10.10.100.254` → `admin`/`admin`. Change the password. STA Wi-Fi on the home LAN; reserve the DHCP lease.
3. Socket A = TCP Server, transparent, port 8899. Serial 9600 8N1. UART idle 20 ms. Not Modbus gateway / MQTT / PUSR cloud.
4. Enter that reserved IP below. One Home Assistant client only.

Serial USB and Modbus-TCP gateways are not available in v1.

data_description.host: Reserved LAN IP of the USR-DR164. One Home Assistant TCP client only.
data_description.port: Socket A port. Factory default is 8899.

profile.title: Heat pump profile
profile.description:
{detect_note}

Keep that choice unless the name on the case is a different family. Compatible badges are listed on each option.

data_description.profile: Pick by how the unit talks, not only the sticker. Oasis / Warmpool / ECPI / irriPool → Hayward. Azuro / Mountfield → MIDA Cosma. SuperMini / Thermotec → PHNIX Mini. Fairland/Norsup menu H37 slave 50 → CN13. IPS Pro / InverX / IPHCR → coil map. Not listed? Unknown heat pump — dump only. AquaTemp on the phone does not prove this wire map.

options_setup.title: Options
options_setup.description: {bus_note} Write path: DTU slave 99 if the factory WiFi module is on the bus; slave 2 if it is not. Service settings (H/F/D special-menu parameters) can damage the unit. Leave them off unless you know the OEM values.

data_description.name: How this heat pump appears in Home Assistant.
data_description.write_path: DTU slave 99 when the factory WiFi module is on the bus. Slave 2 if it is not. Do not unplug a live DTU while the path is still slave 99.
data_description.poll_interval: How often Fairland-style units are polled. Cosma and Mini broadcast and ignore this.
data_description.service_menu_writes: Leave this off unless you know the OEM numbers. Wrong H, F, or D values can damage or brick the heat pump.
data_description.poll_slave: Fairland CN13 menu H37. Default 50. IPS Pro is usually 1.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure DR164
reconfigure.description: Change the reserved LAN IP or port if the DR164 moved. Profile, write path, and H37 stay under Configure.
